channel.title: Threat Pulse — CISA KEV additions
channel.description: Source-traceable CISA catalog additions; not environment-specific findings.

item.title: CVE-2026-109619 — PHP Group / PHP
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-26. PHP Stale Internal Request-State Vulnerability. PHP contains a stale internal request-state vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-109618 — PHP Group / PHP
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-26. PHP Memory Corruption Vulnerability. PHP contains an out-of-memory corruption vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-114625 — Arista / VeloCloud Orchestrator
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-23. Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator SQL Injection Vulnerability. Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator on-prem contains a SQL injection vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-110447 — Collabora / Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-23. Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server OS Command Injection Vulnerability. Collabora Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server when used within the NextCloud platform contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows for remote code execution when the CODE server isn't running. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-96656 — Plex / Media Server
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-20. Plex Media Server External Control of File Name or Path Vulnerability. Plex Media Server contains an external control of file name or path vulnerability which can allow an admin user to write arbitrary files that may be executed on load. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96655. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-96655 — Plex / Media Server
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-20. Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability. Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to request arbitrary internal or external addresses via the '/video/:/transcode/universal' path parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96656. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-96654 — Plex / Media Server
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-20. Plex Media Server Improper Neutralization of Encoded URI Schemes in a Web Page Vulnerability. Plex Media Server contains an improper neutralization of encoded URI schemes in a web page vulnerability that could allow an attacker to call other plugins' functions and supply their own parameters. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-96652 — Plex / Media Server
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-20. Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability. Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability which could allow an attacker using any X-Plex-Token value to include a full URL in the 'protocol' parameter and force the Plex server to POST to the attacker's chosen destination. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96654, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-110936 — Siemens / Software Center
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-20. Siemens Software Center Uncontrolled Search Path Element Vulnerability. Siemens Software Center contains an uncontrolled search path element vulnerability that could allow an authenticated local attacker to place a specially crafted DLL in a directory that the application searches, leading to arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the affected application. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-106931 — EG Secure Solutions / SiteGuard Server Edition
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-20. EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition OS Command Injection Vulnerability. EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition contains an OS command injection vulnerability which may allow an attacker to execute arbitrary OS commands with root or SYSTEM privileges on the system running the affected product. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-102764 — BeyondTrust / Remote Support
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-16. BeyondTrust Remote Support Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability. BeyondTrust Remote Support contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to perform file operations on the appliance. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2025-61624 — Fortinet / Multiple Products
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-16. Fortinet Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability. FortiOS, FortiPAM, FortiProxy, and FortiSwitchManager contain a path traversal vulnerability that may allow an authenticated attacker with admin profile and at least read-write permissions to write or delete arbitrary files via specific CLI commands. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-21589 — Atlassian / Multiple Products
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-15. Atlassian Multiple Products Files or Directories Accessible to External Parties Vulnerability. Multiple Atlassian products (Bitbucket Data Center ,Confluence Data Center, Jira Service Management Data Center, Jira Software Data Center, Bamboo Data Center, Crowd Data Center, Crucible and Fisheye) contain a files or directories accessible to external parties vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to access specific files within the web application root directory in affected versions. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-76519 — Cisco / Secure Email Gateway
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-14. Cisco Secure Email Gateway Relative Path Traversal Vulnerability. Cisco Secure Email Gateway contains a relative path traversal vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying operating system. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-105134 — Ahsay / AhsayCBS
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-14. Ahsay AhsayCBS Command Injection Vulnerability. Ahsay AhsayCBS contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute operating system commands via manipulation of the random parameter in the Replication Receiver component’s /rps/api/json/UpdateReceivers.do endpoint. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105133. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-105133 — Ahsay / AhsayCBS
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-14. Ahsay AhsayCBS Improper Authentication Vulnerability. Ahsay AhsayCBS contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to bypass authentication via manipulation of the random parameter in the API component’s checkSysPwd function. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105134. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-0322 — Palo Alto Networks / PAN-OS
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-14. Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Code Injection Vulnerability. Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an authenticated attacker with network access to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the firewall. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-96951 — Microsoft / Windows
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-13. Microsoft Windows Command Injection Vulnerability. Microsoft Windows Shell contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-104935 — Ivanti / Connect Secure
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-13. Ivanti Connect Secure Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability. Ivanti Connect Secure contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2023-22894 — Strapi / Strapi
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-08. Strapi Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information Vulnerability. Strapi contains a cleartext storage of sensitive information vulnerability that could allow attackers with access to the admin panel to discover sensitive user details via the query filter. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2023-22621 to achieve remote code execution. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2021-3199 — ONLYOFFICE / Docs
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-08. ONLYOFFICE Docs Server Path Traversal Vulnerability. ONLYOFFICE Docs contains a path traversal vulnerability that can occur when JWT is used, via a /.. sequence in an image upload parameter and could allow for remote code execution. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2016-3081 — Apache / Struts
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-08. Apache Struts Command Injection Vulnerability. Apache Struts contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via method:prefix when Dynamic Method Invocation is enabled. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2015-5477 — ISC / BIND
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-08. ISC BIND Data Processing Errors Vulnerability. ISC BIND contains a data processing errors vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to cause a denial of service via TKEY queries. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2015-3306 — ProFTPD / ProFTPD
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-08. ProFTPD Improper Access Control Vulnerability. ProFTPD contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to read and write to arbitrary files via the site cpfr and site cpto commands. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-88779 — Citrix / NetScaler
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-04. Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability. Citrix NetScaler ADC (formerly Citrix ADC) and Citrix NetScaler Gateway (formerly Citrix Gateway) contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for a denial of service. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-102490 — Zammad GmbH / Zammad
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-02. Zammad GmbH Zammad Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability. Zammad GmbH Zammad contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that can allow the local zammad user to escalate privileges to root. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102489. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-102489 — Zammad GmbH / Zammad
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-02. Zammad GmbH Zammad Session Fixation Vulnerability. Zammad GmbH Zammad contains a session fixation vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution as the zammad user. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102490. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-104286 — Fortinet / FortiMail
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-01. Fortinet FortiMail Path Traversal Vulnerability. Fortinet FortiMail contains a path traversal and an improper neutralization of NULL byte or NULL character vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying system via crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-76504 — Cisco / Catalyst SD-WAN Manager
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-09-30. Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Hex Encoding Vulnerability. Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains a hex encoding vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to access an affected system with privileges of the admin user due to improper handling of URI encoding in an HTTP request. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-86950 — Apple / Multiple Products
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-09-29. Apple Multiple Products Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability. Apple iOS, macOS, and iPadOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in CoreGraphics that may lead to arbitrary code execution. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.
